name: Oncology: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors in Advanced NSCLC Corpus
description: Second research domain, added alongside continued GLP-1 depth work per docs/roadmap.md's 'Decision: domain diversification beyond GLP-1'. Mirrors glp1_weight_loss's shape: one bounded population/intervention pair, not oncology in general.
scientific_domain: oncology -- immune checkpoint inhibitors in advanced non-small-cell lung cancer

research_question.text: Do immune checkpoint inhibitors (anti-PD-1/PD-L1) improve overall survival in adults with advanced non-small-cell lung cancer?

notes: 2026-08-08: first bulk seeding batch. 10 discovery-cycle-run cycles scanned ~1000 raw PubMed candidates, yielding 478 unique deterministically-accepted candidates; a documented rule-based title scope screen (see docs/oncology_corpus_scoping.md) selected 336, all of which were acquired as real PMC OA PDFs and imported (335 imported, 1 skipped as a duplicate). sources.csv now has 336 rows, all approved_open_access/included. study_type/population/intervention/comparator fields are intentionally blank pending evidence-record-level review -- this is bulk ingestion metadata, not yet a reviewed evidence base. Local PDFs remain ignored and are not part of the repository; the working database growth is committed via data/db_parts/ (see docs/corpus_database_chunked_versioning.md).
